exercises.title: LabBook Milestone 1 — Review the User Stories, then Write Test Conditions
exercises.problemHtml:
LabBook Project · Milestone 1 — Review the Test Basis and Write Test Conditions

Running project · chapter 1 · early testing on user stories · traceable test conditions · 10 marks

1. Overview

This is the first milestone of the LabBook running project, which you will test chapter after chapter until system testing (Lab 4 / Report 5.3). Coding has not started yet. The product owner sends the user stories of release 1.0 — your test basis. Before a single line of code exists, you review them and derive the test conditions.

 1  US1 Log in
 2    As a student, I want to log in with my FPT e-mail so that only students can book.
 3    AC1.1 Valid e-mail and password: the dashboard is shown.
 4    AC1.2 After several wrong passwords the account is locked.
 5  US2 View labs
 6    As a student, I want to see all labs and their free seats.
 7    AC2.1 Labs are listed with name, capacity and free seats.
 8    AC2.2 The list loads quickly.
 9  US3 Book a seat
10    As a student, I want to book a seat in a lab for a time slot.
11    AC3.1 Start hour 7-20, duration 1-3 hours.
12    AC3.2 A booking must end by 21:00.
13    AC3.3 When the lab is full, the booking is refused.
14    AC3.4 When the lab is full, the student is put on the waiting list as PENDING.
15  US4 Weekly limit
16    As the lab manager, I want to limit each student to 6 hours per week.
17    AC4.1 A booking is refused if the student's total would exceed 6 hours.
18    AC4.2 Cancelled bookings do not count.
19  US5 Cancel a booking
20    As a student, I want to cancel my booking free of charge.
21    AC5.1 A booking can be cancelled until 2 hours before the start.
22    AC5.2 Cancelling a confirmed booking promotes the first pending student.
23  US6 Close a lab
24    As the lab manager, I want to close a lab for maintenance.
25    AC6.1 A closed lab cannot be booked.
26    AC6.2 Lab supervisors can reopen the lab.
27  Glossary: week = Monday 00:00 to Sunday 23:59, Vietnam time.

Main features

  • A. Review log of the stories: line, type, severity, description and a rewritten criterion as the fix.
  • B. Test conditions traced to the stories.
  • C. Name the activity, the work product, the principle and the kind of testing.

General requirements

  • A requirement defect is anything that would make two readers build or test different things: ambiguity, contradiction, a missing rule, an unmeasurable criterion, an inconsistent term.

2. Required project structure

answers/
├── review.js      ← const ISSUES = [ { line, type, severity, description, fix } ]
├── conditions.js  ← const CONDITIONS = [ { id, story: 'US1'…'US6', text } ]
└── milestone.js   ← const MILESTONE = { activity, workProduct, principle, kind }

3. Data model

Allowed values

FieldTypeNotes
ISSUES[].typestringAMBIGUOUS · CONTRADICTION · INCOMPLETE · UNTESTABLE · INCONSISTENT
MILESTONE.activitystringone of the 7 CTFL 2018 test activities
MILESTONE.principlestringthe full name of one of the 7 principles
MILESTONE.kindstringStatic · Dynamic

4. Functional requirements

1. A. Review of the stories 5 marks

Requirements:

  • At least 8 real requirement defects including the four critical ones; no false claim; each fix is a rewritten, testable criterion.

Must use: early testing requirements review

2. B. Test conditions 3 marks

Requirements:

  • ≥ 14 conditions, every story covered, ≥ 3 for US3 and US4, the weekly-limit boundary.

Must use: test analysis traceability

3. C. Where we are in the process 2 marks

Requirements:

  • Activity, work product, principle, static/dynamic.

Must use: test process

5. Element ids / classes used by the auto-grader

SelectorPurpose
ISSUESanswers/review.js
CONDITIONSanswers/conditions.js
MILESTONEanswers/milestone.js

6. Grading rubric

#FeatureMarks
1A. Review of the stories5
2B. Test conditions3
3C. Where we are in the process2
Total10

Common deductions

  • Calling AC3.1 and AC3.2 a contradiction — they combine into one rule.
  • Reporting “week” as undefined — read the glossary.

7. Submission

Write your answers in the answer files on the right (they mirror the official template: one JavaScript object per test case / issue). Press Run for the visible checks and Submit for full grading, hidden checks included. Your score per question appears in the rubric table.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
LabBook Project · Milestone 1 — Review the Test Basis and Write Test Conditions

Dự án xuyên suốt · chương 1 · test sớm trên user story · test condition có truy vết · 10 điểm

1. Tổng quan

Đây là mốc đầu của dự án xuyên suốt LabBook, bạn sẽ kiểm thử nó qua từng chương tới system test (Lab 4 / Report 5.3). Chưa ai viết mã. Product owner gửi các user story của bản 1.0 — test basis của bạn. Trước khi có dòng mã nào, bạn review chúng và suy ra test condition.

Tóm tắt: US1 đăng nhập (khoá tài khoản sau “vài lần” sai) · US2 xem phòng (“tải nhanh”) · US3 đặt chỗ (giờ 7–20, 1–3 giờ, kết thúc trước 21:00, phòng đầy thì… hai tiêu chí) · US4 giới hạn 6 giờ/tuần · US5 huỷ “miễn phí” tới 2 giờ trước, nâng người chờ đầu tiên · US6 đóng/mở phòng · thuật ngữ “tuần”.

Chức năng chính

  • A. Nhật ký review story: dòng, loại, mức độ, mô tả và tiêu chí viết lại làm cách sửa.
  • B. Test condition truy vết về story.
  • C. Gọi tên hoạt động, sản phẩm, nguyên tắc và loại kiểm thử.

Yêu cầu chung

  • Lỗi yêu cầu là bất cứ thứ gì khiến hai người đọc xây hay test ra hai thứ khác nhau: mơ hồ, mâu thuẫn, thiếu luật, tiêu chí không đo được, thuật ngữ không nhất quán.

2. Cấu trúc thư mục bắt buộc

answers/
├── review.js      ← const ISSUES = [ { line, type, severity, description, fix } ]
├── conditions.js  ← const CONDITIONS = [ { id, story: 'US1'…'US6', text } ]
└── milestone.js   ← const MILESTONE = { activity, workProduct, principle, kind }

3. Mô hình dữ liệu

Allowed values

TrườngKiểuGhi chú
ISSUES[].typestringAMBIGUOUS · CONTRADICTION · INCOMPLETE · UNTESTABLE · INCONSISTENT
MILESTONE.activitystringmột trong 7 hoạt động CTFL 2018
MILESTONE.principlestringtên đầy đủ của một trong 7 nguyên tắc
MILESTONE.kindstringStatic · Dynamic

4. Yêu cầu chức năng

1. A. Review story 5 điểm

Yêu cầu:

  • Ít nhất 8 lỗi yêu cầu thật gồm bốn lỗi nghiêm trọng; không khẳng định sai; mỗi cách sửa là một tiêu chí viết lại, test được.

Bắt buộc dùng: early testing requirements review

2. B. Test condition 3 điểm

Yêu cầu:

  • ≥ 14 condition, phủ mọi story, ≥ 3 cho US3 và US4, có biên giới hạn tuần.

Bắt buộc dùng: test analysis traceability

3. C. Ta đang ở đâu trong quy trình 2 điểm

Yêu cầu:

  • Hoạt động, sản phẩm, nguyên tắc, tĩnh/động.

Bắt buộc dùng: test process

5. id / class máy chấm dùng

SelectorVai trò
ISSUESanswers/review.js
CONDITIONSanswers/conditions.js
MILESTONEanswers/milestone.js

6. Thang điểm

#Chức năngĐiểm
1A. Review story5
2B. Test condition3
3C. Ta đang ở đâu trong quy trình2
Tổng10

Lỗi hay bị trừ điểm

  • Gọi AC3.1 và AC3.2 là mâu thuẫn — chúng gộp thành một luật.
  • Báo “week” chưa định nghĩa — hãy đọc phần thuật ngữ.

7. Nộp bài

Viết câu trả lời vào các tệp bên phải (giống template chính thức: mỗi test case / lỗi là một object JavaScript). Bấm Chạy thử để chạy kiểm hiện, Nộp để chấm đủ (kể cả kiểm ẩn). Điểm từng câu hiện trong bảng thang điểm.

B: mỗi tiêu chí chấp nhận cho ít nhất một condition; luật số (giờ, thời lượng, 6 giờ) cho cả phía hợp lệ, không hợp lệ và biên.

solutionCodeJson.name: answers/review.js
solutionCodeJson.code:
// Review of the LabBook 1.0 user stories (test basis) — 11 issues.
const ISSUES = [
  { line: 4, type: 'AMBIGUOUS', severity: 'High', description: '“several wrong passwords”: how many attempts, and for how long is the account locked? Not testable as written.', fix: 'After 5 consecutive wrong passwords the account is locked for 15 minutes.' },
  { line: 13, type: 'CONTRADICTION', severity: 'High', description: 'AC3.3 refuses a booking when the lab is full, AC3.4 puts the student on the waiting list.', fix: 'Delete AC3.3 or state when each applies; keep the waiting list (PENDING).' },
  { line: 8, type: 'UNTESTABLE', severity: 'Medium', description: '“loads quickly” has no measurable criterion.', fix: 'The list is shown within 2 seconds for 95% of requests with 200 users.' },
  { line: 21, type: 'INCOMPLETE', severity: 'High', description: '“free of charge” suggests a fee later; the rule after the 2-hour limit is missing.', fix: 'Less than 2 hours before the start the cancellation is refused with TOO_LATE.' },
  { line: 17, type: 'INCOMPLETE', severity: 'Medium', description: 'Does a PENDING (waiting-list) booking count towards the 6 hours?', fix: 'Only CONFIRMED bookings count towards the weekly limit.' },
  { line: 22, type: 'AMBIGUOUS', severity: 'Medium', description: '“first pending student”: first by request time? Same lab, date and slot only?', fix: 'The earliest PENDING request for the same lab, date and slot is promoted.' },
  { line: 26, type: 'INCONSISTENT', severity: 'Low', description: '“lab supervisors” is not a role; US6 talks about the lab manager.', fix: 'The lab manager can reopen the lab.' },
  { line: 25, type: 'INCOMPLETE', severity: 'Medium', description: 'Existing bookings of a closed lab are not handled.', fix: 'Closing a lab cancels its future bookings and e-mails the students.' },
  { line: 11, type: 'INCOMPLETE', severity: 'Medium', description: 'No rule for past dates or how far ahead a student may book.', fix: 'Bookings are allowed from today up to 14 days ahead.' },
  { line: 3, type: 'INCOMPLETE', severity: 'Medium', description: 'Only the happy path is specified: wrong password and non-FPT e-mail are missing.', fix: 'Add: wrong password → error message; e-mail not ending in @fpt.edu.vn → refused.' },
  { line: 7, type: 'AMBIGUOUS', severity: 'Low', description: '“free seats” for which time? Are closed labs listed?', fix: 'Free seats for the selected date and slot; closed labs shown as CLOSED.' },
];

  { id: 'TCO-06', story: 'US2', text: 'Response time of the lab list against the agreed limit' },
  { id: 'TCO-07', story: 'US3', text: 'Start hour inside and outside 7-20 (boundaries 7 and 20)' },
  { id: 'TCO-08', story: 'US3', text: 'Duration inside and outside 1-3 hours' },
  { id: 'TCO-09', story: 'US3', text: 'Booking that would end after 21:00 is refused' },
  { id: 'TCO-10', story: 'US3', text: 'Booking a full lab puts the student on the waiting list as PENDING' },
  { id: 'TCO-11', story: 'US4', text: 'Weekly total below 6 hours is accepted' },
  { id: 'TCO-12', story: 'US4', text: 'Weekly total reaching exactly 6 hours is accepted (boundary)' },
  { id: 'TCO-13', story: 'US4', text: 'Weekly total above 6 hours is refused' },
  { id: 'TCO-14', story: 'US4', text: 'Cancelled bookings are not counted in the weekly total' },

  { id: 'TCO-18', story: 'US6', text: 'A closed lab cannot be booked' },

];

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: Critical: line 4 (lockout undefined), 13–14 (full lab: refused vs waiting list), 8 (untestable “quickly”), 20–21 (after 2 h?). Others: PENDING and the weekly limit, “first pending”, lab supervisors, bookings of a closed lab, booking horizon, negative login cases, “free seats”. Test conditions are the output of test analysis; reviewing before code is static testing and shows that early testing saves time and money.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Nghiêm trọng: dòng 4, 13–14, 8, 20–21. Còn lại: PENDING và giới hạn tuần, “chờ đầu tiên”, lab supervisor, booking của phòng đóng, thời hạn đặt trước, đăng nhập sai, “chỗ trống”. Test condition là sản phẩm của test analysis; review trước khi có mã là kiểm thử tĩnh và thể hiện test sớm tiết kiệm thời gian và tiền.

exercises.title: LabBook Interview corner 1 — Talking about testing fundamentals
exercises.problemHtml:
Interview corner. Questions an interviewer asks a fresher QA or developer about the basics. Choose the answer that would impress — concrete, honest, linked to a project.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Góc phỏng vấn. Câu người phỏng vấn hay hỏi QA/developer mới ra trường về kiến thức nền. Chọn câu trả lời gây ấn tượng — cụ thể, thật thà, gắn với dự án.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

starterCodeJson.code:
# LabBook Interview corner 1 — Talking about testing fundamentals

Answer in the answer panel (no code needed).

1. “What is the difference between QA and testing?”“QA khác testing thế nào?”
2. “A developer says your bug is ‘not a bug, works on my machine’. What do you do?”“Developer nói lỗi của bạn ‘không phải lỗi, máy tôi chạy được’. Bạn làm gì?”
3. “When do you stop testing?”“Khi nào bạn dừng test?”
4. “Give an example of finding a defect early.”“Cho ví dụ về tìm lỗi sớm.”
5. “Can testing prove that software has no bugs?”“Testing có chứng minh được phần mềm hết lỗi không?”

solutionCodeJson.code:
# LabBook Interview corner 1 — Talking about testing fundamentals — answer key

1. “What is the difference between QA and testing?”“QA khác testing thế nào?”
   Answer: b) “QA is about the process that prevents defects; testing is a quality-control activity that evaluates the product. In LabBook we did both: a review checklist for stories (process) and test cases (product).”
   Definition + a concrete example.VI: Định nghĩa + ví dụ cụ thể.

2. “A developer says your bug is ‘not a bug, works on my machine’. What do you do?”“Developer nói lỗi của bạn ‘không phải lỗi, máy tôi chạy được’. Bạn làm gì?”
   Answer: b) Stay factual: share exact steps, build, environment and logs, reproduce it together, and compare with the requirement
   Collaboration, not battles; facts and the requirement decide.VI: Hợp tác, không gây chiến; sự kiện và yêu cầu quyết định.

3. “When do you stop testing?”“Khi nào bạn dừng test?”
   Answer: b) “When the exit criteria agreed in the plan are met — coverage of high-risk requirements, no open critical defects — or when the risk is accepted by the stakeholders.”
   Exhaustive testing is impossible; exit criteria and risk decide.VI: Không thể test vét cạn; tiêu chí ra và rủi ro quyết định.

4. “Give an example of finding a defect early.”“Cho ví dụ về tìm lỗi sớm.”
   Answer: b) “Reviewing LabBook’s stories I saw that a full lab was both refused and wait-listed. Fixing one sentence then saved a feature built twice.”
   Concrete story + impact, principle 3.VI: Câu chuyện cụ thể + tác động, nguyên tắc 3.

5. “Can testing prove that software has no bugs?”“Testing có chứng minh được phần mềm hết lỗi không?”
   Answer: b) “No. Testing shows the presence of defects and reduces the risk, but cannot prove absence — 100% code coverage still misses missing requirements.”
   Principle 1, with a reason that shows understanding.VI: Nguyên tắc 1, kèm lý do thể hiện hiểu sâu.

6. “Why do you want to be a tester?”“Vì sao bạn muốn làm tester?”
   Answer: b) “I enjoy asking ‘what could go wrong?’, I like protecting users, and I want to grow into automation and quality engineering — I have already practised it on LabBook.”
   Curiosity, users, growth, evidence.VI: Tò mò, người dùng, phát triển, bằng chứng.
